defective_pattern: Generating isolated JSON statistical payloads in micro-stages without synchronously synthesizing and emitting the corresponding Markdown (.md) and Word (.docx) deliverables before triggering validation or declaring completion.
why_defective: Violates Directive 3 Triad Invariant. It fragments the deliverables, decoupling data from narrative and formatting, and causes validation cascades to fail because the triad is incomplete.
observed_symptoms: Validation failures complaining about missing .md or .docx files.
Micro-stage completes but leaves only .json files.
Decoupled pipelines triggering global validation too early.
corrective_remedy: Micro-stage execution must sequentially and completely synthesize all three components (.json, .md, .docx) within the same micro-stage phase before triggering directory-wide validation gates or declaring the micro-stage complete.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting micro-stage completion or validation trigger when only JSON payload has been created and MD/DOCX are missing
